谷歌推出了WeatherNext 3，这是一种先进的人工智能模型，通过使用实时卫星数据而不是传统的物理模拟来提供更准确、高分辨率的天气预报。此更新提供每小时的本地化预测，其准确性比以前的版本高出五倍，为农业、可再生能源和日常规划提供了重大改进。您现在可以直接通过 Google 搜索、地图和 Gemini 访问这些增强的预测，或者通过 Google Cloud 将数据集成到您自己的项目中。
谷歌刚刚发布了 WeatherNext 3，这是一种人工智能模型，可以使天气预报更快、更准确。它使用实时卫星数据每小时更新一次，让您更清晰地了解外面发生的事情。这可以帮助人们更好地应对暴风雨或晴天等情况。它现在为您在 Google 搜索和地图中看到的天气信息提供支持。
每天，天气都会影响数十亿个决策。有些就像出门前拿把雨伞一样简单，但另一些则更为重要。风、雨和极端天气事件（如热浪和干旱）会对农业、全球供应链、清洁能源生产和国民经济产生连锁影响。
近年来，人工智能彻底改变了天气预报，利用历史记录比传统方法更快、更准确地进行预测。然而，预测高度本地化和快速变化的天气仍然是一个挑战。以前的模型通常缺乏足够的空间分辨率，并且难以整合来自卫星等来源的实时天气数据。
今天，Google DeepMind 和 Google Research 推出了 WeatherNext 3，根据 Brightband 的独立实时评估，这是迄今为止最先进、最准确的全球天气模型。我们的模型直接从实时观测中学习，使其能够为对人们影响最大的天气事件提供及时且更本地化的预测。通过使用原始卫星数据每小时生成高分辨率预测，我们的模型可以在全球各地的 Google 产品中提供可靠的预测。
预测的效用通常取决于细节以及它对时间和空间的解析程度。 WeatherNext 3 以多种空间分辨率生成每小时预报，保持从广泛的全球风型一直到当地地形的物理一致性。
借助 WeatherNext 3，我们可以以 5 公里的分辨率可视化关键的表面变量（例如温度和湿度），以 10 公里的分辨率可视化其他表面变量，以及以 25 公里的分辨率可视化大气变量（例如风速）。总体而言，这提供的全球天气图比我们之前的模型 WeatherNext 2 清晰大约五倍，后者以 6 小时为增量在 25 公里网格上生成预报。
图 1：端到端 WeatherNext 3 系统架构。该模型摄取实时的 1 小时对地静止卫星镶嵌数据以及传统的历史分析，为单个灵活的功能生成网络 (FGN) 网状变压器提供数据。它输出密集的网格场、离散的气旋轨迹，并本地预测站级稀疏坐标。

content: Coinbase 设计系统团队对 Code Connect 进行了针对编码代理的测试，发现它提高了设计系统的依从性，同时平均降低了 22.5% 的代币成本。

Coinbase 设计系统 (CDS) 团队为消费者和企业提供跨移动和网络的美国最大的加密货币交易所的支持。他们已经扩展了设计系统的质量、一致性和可访问性，但是当其主要用户从工程师转向代理商时，需要改变什么？技术主管 Erich Kuerschner 看到了使用 Figma MCP 服务器改进代理输出的机会 MCP 的 TL;DR：为什么上下文很重要以及如何将其投入工作 Figma 的 MCP 服务器将您的设计决策带入编写代码的工具中 - 因此构建的内容实际上与设计的内容相匹配。以下是每个构建产品的人可以解锁的东西。
当从设计到代码时，代理缺乏生产组件的上下文。通过 Figma 的 MCP 中的 Code Connect，他们可以获得该上下文。我们测量了它对令牌使用、任务持续时间和代码质量的影响。
“测试向我们表明，Code Connect 通常会减少代理在将 Figma 设计转换为代码时需要花费的代币数量，”他说。 “由于 Code Connect 提供了更好的上下文，代码的质量明显更好。”以下是 CDS 团队如何通过 Code Connect 适应新的工程工作流程，并衡量其对时间、质量和成本的影响。

CDS 团队已经掌握了一些代理技能，可以教会代理遵循其设计系统的最佳实践：为工作选择正确的组件、避免弃用的组件和模式、使用 CDS 设计令牌等等。他们在这些技能的基础上建立了一个内部原型设计游乐场，因此默认情况下，那里的任何东西都坚持 CDS。但两者都是为了从头开始编写代码而进行调整的。另一个常见的工作流程仍然没有得到充分利用：将 Figma 设计转变为生产质量的 CDS 代码。产品工程师告诉团队，这个过程缓慢、不准确且难以预测，无法纳入他们的常规工作流程。
Code Connect 是显而易见的杠杆，但自 Figma MCP 服务器发布之前 CDS 就没有更新其映射。现有的东西已经过时了，许多新组件根本没有模板。 “根据我对 Code Connect 的了解，这是一种提高设计到代码工作流程可靠性的方法，而不必仅仅依赖我们的代理技能，”Erich 说。
全面采用 Code Connect 设置并使其现代化将涉及对移动和网络上的数百个组件进行更新。 Erich 使用 Claude Code 构建了一个代理工作流程，该工作流程采用 Figma 组件列表并并行处理它们，并使用Figma-code-connect 技能编写模板。 “在大约四个小时内，我们从将一些组件迁移到更新的 Code Connect 格式，到完全覆盖我们的设计系统，”他说。
如今，Figma 中的每个 CDS 组件都通过 Code Connect 连接到代码中的同级组件。 Code Connect 是 CDS 工程团队每个组件工作流程的一部分。该团队使用 Figma MCP 服务器来提取设计规范、创建或更新代码中的组件，并使组件相应的 Code Connect 模板与最新更改保持同步。
现在是时候根据代币使用情况和实施时间（无论有没有 Code Connect）对代理输出的质量进行基准测试了。 “我们想了解 Code Connect 为我们带来了什么，以及它是否有助于解决我们的产品工程师对设计到代码工作流程可靠性的担忧，”Erich 说。
他在空白代码库中使用相同的设计、提示和模型（Sonnet 4.6）运行了三次，并在每次运行后进行重置，以“确保没有任何残留的线索可供下一个特工蚕食，”他说。他还必须控制即时缓存，这有可能影响实验，由于与 Code Connect 无关的原因产生积极的测试结果。提示很简单并且故意含糊不清：从 Figma 实现此设计，并提供设计文件的链接。

items.oneLiner: 我们最新的 Gemini 模型为代理工作流程和网络安全提供了下一代智能。

summary.oneSentence: 我们最新的 Gemini 模型为代理工作流程和网络安全提供了下一代智能。
bullets: 我们最新的 Gemini 模型为代理工作流程和网络安全提供了下一代智能。
凭借三周前 3.7 Flash 的势头，并标志着我们在短短六周内发布的第三个 Flash，今天我们推出 Gemini 3.8，这是我们迄今为止最好的推理和编码模型，其速度和成本与 3.7 相同。 Gemini 3.8 引入了 2 个变体：
虽然针对不同的部署环境进行了定制，但今天的两个版本均由相同的基础智能提供支持，并通过旨在递归评估和完善底层模型的长期运行的代理循环进一步加速。这一共享核心的显着编码和推理收益是由多项创新推动的，包括在要求极高的网络安全领域的严格培训。
Gemini 3.8 Flash 较 3.7 Flash 具有显着优势，通常接近成本较高的前沿型号的性能。

insight.mainInsight: Google DeepMind 官网发布：我们最新的 Gemini 模型为代理工作流程和网络安全提供了下一代智能。

content: 我们最新的 Gemini 模型为代理工作流程和网络安全提供了下一代智能。
凭借三周前 3.7 Flash 的势头，并标志着我们在短短六周内发布的第三个 Flash，今天我们推出 Gemini 3.8，这是我们迄今为止最好的推理和编码模型，其速度和成本与 3.7 相同。 Gemini 3.8 引入了 2 个变体：
虽然针对不同的部署环境进行了定制，但今天的两个版本均由相同的基础智能提供支持，并通过旨在递归评估和完善底层模型的长期运行的代理循环进一步加速。这一共享核心的显着编码和推理收益是由多项创新推动的，包括在要求极高的网络安全领域的严格培训。
Gemini 3.8 Flash 较 3.7 Flash 具有显着优势，通常接近成本较高的前沿型号的性能。
在 DeepSWE v1.1（长视野软件工程）3.8 上，Flash 在端到端自主解决复杂工程问题方面优于大多数较大的前沿模型，而成本仅为其一小部分。

此外，3.8 Flash 还展示了跨专业知识领域的关键企业自治所需的可靠性。在需要高级分析和报告的定量和专业领域，3.8 Flash 在 Vals Finance Agent V2 和 Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark 等基准测试中优于 3.7 Flash 和其他前沿模型。 3.8 Flash 在 HLE-Verified 上也取得了 54.9% 的成绩，展示了其跨 STEM、人文和专业领域处理多步推理的能力。
这些性能提升源于核心设计选择：3.8 闪存更加努力。在复杂的任务上，它表现出更大的勤奋——执行额外的推理步骤，并迭代地调用工具。有时，模型可能会使用更多令牌来最大限度地提高性能，尤其是在更高的工作量水平上。
对于计算效率是主要限制的应用程序，开发人员可以利用较低的工作量来最大限度地减少令牌开销，或者继续依赖 Gemini 3.7 Flash，后者仍然完全支持效率优先的工作负载。

Gemini 3.8 Flash 在 Google Antigravity 的单个提示中构建了功能齐全的 DOS 版本的 Google 地图，可以完全播放位置、方向和街景视图。

summary.oneSentence: 你的代码库、构建产物和密钥都保留在你基础设施中运行的内部机器上，由智能体在本地处理工具调用。
bullets: 你的代码库、构建产物和密钥都保留在你基础设施中运行的内部机器上，由智能体在本地处理工具调用。
My Machines 将单台笔记本电脑或 VM 连接到你的账户，用于个人工作流。
团队池 是面向团队或企业的具名 worker 队列。容量会随请求到来而扩容，并在 worker 断开连接时缩容，让你的自托管机器随需求弹性伸缩。池不与某个代码仓库绑定：只需指定池名称，任何空闲的 worker 都可以领取该请求。
池还可以让闲置机器休眠，并在收到后续消息时于重连窗口内恢复，这样你就不必只为等下一个提示而一直让昂贵的容量保持热运行。

您的浏览器不支持音频元素。

Google 刚刚推出了针对 Gemini 3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash 和 3.5 Flash-Lite 的代理视频理解功能。此功能允许模型动态扫描视频片段，从而提高准确性，同时将令牌使用量减少高达 88%，成本减少高达 66%。您今天可以通过在 Google AI Studio 或 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 中将 API 配置设置为“agentic”来开始使用此功能。

今天，我们在最新型号上推出了代理视频理解功能：Gemini 3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash 和 3.5 Flash-Lite。这项新功能提高了准确性，同时大大减少了视频分析的令牌使用量和成本。与将代码执行与 Gemini 模型的本机图像理解相结合的代理视觉类似，代理视频理解使用 Gemini 的本机视频工具来提高性能并解锁视频处理的新功能，例如亚秒级时刻检索、更准确的异常检测、精确计数等。
该功能现已推出，可通过 Google AI Studio 和 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 中的 Gemini API 上传视频和 YouTube 视频。
与当前的“静态”处理不同，模型以固定的每秒帧速率（默认 1 FPS，可通过 API 调整）摄取视频，代理视频理解将模型的核心推理与本机视频工具配对，以动态搜索、扫描和检查跨视觉帧、音频和文字记录的目标视频片段。在标准视频分析基准中，具有代理视频理解功能的 Gemini 模型可将分析成本降低高达 66%，将令牌消耗降低高达 88%，同时将准确性提高高达 7%。
这些效率提升在长视频（从 10 分钟的操作指南到 90 分钟的讲座和多小时的录音）上尤其明显，其中静态处理迫使开发人员在高令牌成本或放弃关键细节的技术之间做出选择。
使用 Gemini 3.7 Flash 激活代理视频理解可将令牌消耗降低高达 88%，并将准确性提高高达 7%。
虽然这些收益涵盖了所有三种受支持的模型，但具有代理理解功能的 Gemini 3.7 Flash 提供了尽可能最佳的整体质量以及质量和成本效率的最佳组合，使其在视频理解测试模型中处于准确性与成本帕累托前沿。
使用代理视频理解将 Gemini 3.7 Flash 置于视频分析的准确性与成本帕累托前沿。

在较高的层面上，着色器可让您在 Figma Design 中直观地操作图层，无论是作为填充还是效果。它们是非常强大的 GPU 程序，可以实时弯曲和改变像素。 2022 年，我构建了噪声和纹理插件，将这种魔力带到了画布上，但没有进一步集成的途径。
如果您想深入了解着色器的工作原理，Dan Hollick 在“制作软件”中的章节和 Patricio Gonzales 的交互式“着色器之书”都是很好的资源。
多年来我一直痴迷于将着色器的强大功能引入 Figma。但直到最近，法学硕士才让我更容易地展示（而不仅仅是“讲述”）我的愿景。首先，我编写了一个行为类似于 Figma 的 WebGPU 环境，您可以在其中将着色器效果添加到画布上的任何图层，包括矢量、3D 图层，甚至粒子系统。我专注于构建三个关键的东西：
虽然我们花了几个月的时间在 Figma Draw 中构建渐进式模糊，但用 Figma Draw 自己表达 Figma Draw 将更快、更简单的矢量编辑与强大的视觉表达工具结合在一起，因此各种类型的设计师都可以在不中断焦点的情况下将他们的愿景变为现实。

具有 2D 后处理流体位移着色器的 3D 嵌入式对象 在我的 WebGPU 环境中通过鼠标交互和物理提示进行布料模拟 我的第一个在渐变填充上提示着色器效果的原型之一 基于粒子引擎的提示 WebGPU 计算着色器 组建合适的团队 我向渲染和动画工程师 Yassir Solomah 求助，并提出了我的问题：这真的有效吗？我是否以正确的方式接近它？这辆坦克在 Figma 中有表现吗？毕竟，WebGPU 画布应用程序的 vivi 编码近似值与企业规模、平铺渲染的真实事物相去甚远。 （尝试制作一个高性能的无限画布。这看似具有挑战性，在网络上构建专业的设计工具我们对设计工具未来的愿景是任何人、任何地方都可以轻松使用工具和内容。
值得庆幸的是，Yassir 加入了。我们拆掉了 WebGL 2 片段着色器系统，并将其替换为 WebGPU 管道系统，因此着色器可以成为微型程序：渲染 3D 对象，并应用基于鼠标位置和时间的逻辑来控制图层内的视觉效果。通过这种架构，我们可以将图形生成脚本隔离在自己的沙箱中，同时充分利用 WebGPU 的强大功能。这意味着更安全的用户运行脚本、逻辑、粒子系统、计算着色器、3D 支持等。

content: 您现在可以使用 AI Gateway 预算为团队中的每个用户设置美元支出限额。
该限制涵盖归因于用户的每个 API 密钥及其应用程序令牌的支出。达到后，AI Gateway 会拒绝新的请求，直到预算重置或增加。
这对于控制编码代理和其他在没有监督的情况下运行的工作负载的支出非常有用，并防止一个用户消耗团队的所有共享预算。
将链接复制到标题 设置用户预算 打开“预算”页面上的“用户”视图以设置两种用户预算：
默认预算：如果设置，则单独适用于没有自定义预算的每个人，包括后来添加的用户。每个用户都有自己的限额，而不是在整个团队中共享一个限额。
自定义预算：适用于一个人并覆盖默认值。删除它会使该用户返回到默认预算。
默认情况下，默认预算和自定义预算都会每月重置，但您可以将其更改为每天、每周重置或根本不重置。预算还支持通过电子邮件发出使用情况警报，以便在您达到分配的 50%、75% 和/或 100% 时发出通知。
用户预算不会取代 API 密钥、项目或团队预算。请求必须保持在适用于它的每个预算范围内。达到任何适用的限制会阻止新请求。
默认情况下，API 密钥归属于创建它们的用户。如果密钥属于生产应用程序或其他共享工作负载，请从 API 密钥页面将其归属于团队，以使其支出超出密钥创建者的预算。在用户预算功能发布之前创建的密钥归属于团队以实现向后兼容性，因此如果您希望当前使用情况属于用户范围，请轮换到新密钥。

当代理在我们的代码库中工作时，这非常有效，因为技能所需的一切都在那里。但是，报告、提案和一次性页面仍然必须看起来像 Vercel，但使用无法读取任何这些文件的工具制作，那又如何呢？对于我们来说，答案是 design.md ，这是任何代理都可以加载的公共文件。

我们最近写了一篇关于产品设计的文章，我们的技能可以教会代理在我们的代码库中工作时如何设计。该技能与它所管理的代码一起存在于每个存储库中，解释代理如何找到和理解我们的设计系统以及他们正在构建的任何产品的指南。
当代理在我们的代码库中工作时，这非常有效，因为技能所需的一切都在那里。但是，报告、提案和一次性页面仍然必须看起来像 Vercel，但使用无法读取任何这些文件的工具制作，那又如何呢？对于我们来说，答案是 design.md ，这是任何代理都可以加载的公共文件。
将链接复制到标题我们如何进行构建设计.md 产品设计之所以能够顺利进行，是因为设计系统和产品指南就位于存储库中供代理商阅读。我们需要一种方法让该环境之外的代理和工具能够获得相同的知识，以便另一端出现的页面仍然看起来像我们自己设计的东西。这提出了两个要求：
任何人都可以将其代理指向的单个公共 URL，无论其运行环境如何。
指南涵盖了使产品设计发挥作用的所有方面，从品牌、布局和文案到设计系统、响应能力和信息架构。
我们首先尝试的简单方法是简单地将产品设计移植到公共提示中，将技能的参考文件折叠成任何代理都可以从 URL 读取的文件。我们发现的问题是，虽然提示很好地描述了我们的视觉语言，但每个阅读它的模型都会以不同的方式解释该描述，从而根据相同的指导生成截然不同的页面。
部分原因在于设计语言是主观的。像“保持布局干净”这样的短语确实可以代表任何意思。什么是“干净”？除此之外，更大的问题是提示留下的其他一切。在我们的代码库中，代理读取由真实组件包围的产品设计，并提供其描述的事物的示例。但公开提示不包括这些，让每个模特都只能从文字中重建我们的风格。
因此，我们需要做的是将环境提供的内容提炼到单个文件中，而了解我们是否更接近的唯一方法是查看出现的页面。我们将端口放在一边，开始从头开始编写一个新文件，这次根据一组可重复的评估提示测试每个更改。

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Introducing wrapture New from Graham Dumpleton (of wrapt , mod_wsgi, and New Relic's Python agent fame), who describes Wrapture as taking the monkeypatching ideas from wrapt and extending them to apply to testing and tracing at the same time. Wrapture ( full documentation here ) makes it easy to wrap any function or method such that all access can be traced, or can be overridden to return a different value. It acts as both an alternative to unittest.mock and a way to implement tracing against an existing project: Attaching observation to code you do not control, recording what flows through it, and doing so without disturbing the program being watched, is a problem I have never really stopped thinking about. Wrapture includes OpenTelemetry support and even has an entirely configuration-based mechanism for adding tracing to an existing Python project, which looks like this: capture = " summary " [[ observe ]] target = " domain:Calculator " name = [ " outer " , " inner " ] [[ sink ]] type = " jsonlines " path = " trace.jsonl " This is still a very young project - just a few weeks old - but it's off to a very promising start. Interestingly, this is also Graham's first attempt at large entirely agent-driven project: Every line of code and documentation in wrapture was written by an AI assistant working under my direction. I want to be upfront about that, and equally upfront about what it was not. This was not vibe coding, where a one-shot prompt produces a pile of generated code and the person driving hopes for the best because they lack the knowledge to judge what came back. Vibe coding has earned its bad reputation. I engineered wrapture carefully from the start. I have spent a long time in this particular corner of Python and knew exactly what the result needed to be, and the AI was the means of producing it rather than the source of the design. In a follow-up post, Unit testing with wrapture , Graham shows the testing patterns supported by the new library: def test_stub_with_wrapture (): with wrapture . binding ( Gateway , "charge" ). on_call . returns ({ "id" : "stub" , "amount" : 0 } ): assert OrderService (). place ( 500 )[ "id" ] == "stub" And this neat example of a test that calls and then modifies the return value from the original method: def test_pinned_result_with_wrapture (): charge = wrapture . binding ( Gateway , "charge" ) charge . on_call . transforms_result ( lambda r : { ** r , "id" : "ch_TEST" } ) with charge : assert OrderService (). place ( 500 ) == { "id" : "ch_TEST" , "amount" : 500 } (In both of these examples the OrderService().place(...) method calls Gateway().charge(...) .) Tags: graham-dumpleton , monkey-patching , python , testing , pytest , observability , ai-assisted-programming , agentic-engineering , opentelemetry

items.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
items.oneLiner: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is

summary.oneSentence: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily
bullets: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so fa

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far. ChatGPT Work is actually two products The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud . If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local . This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers. ( Update : Work Cloud is also available from the ChatGPT desktop app, via a Where should this chat run? dropdown.) For the rest of this article I'm going to talk exclusively about Work Cloud. Work is for paid subscribers only Right now, ChatGPT Work (in both flavors) is available only to $20/month and up subscribers. Free users and $8/month Go users do not have access. Work has features that aren't available in Chat The interface for accessing Work is a tab selector, which presents it as an alternative to Chat: The obvious question is when should I use Chat, and when should I use Work? OpenAI's official answer to that question is: Use Chat when you want an answer, explanation, brainstorm, or short draft. Use ChatGPT Work when you want ChatGPT to complete a task with a clear outcome, such as a brief, deck, analysis, recurring update, workflow, or file you can review and use. I find that almost entirely useless, because I've been using regular ChatGPT Chat for all of those task categories for years! The better question then is what features does Work have that are missing from Chat? After extensive experimentation I think I've mostly figured that out: Options to use Luna and Terra in place of Sol A code execution environment with Internet access A headless Chrome browser A persistent filesystem shared between sessions The ability to publish ChatGPT Sites The ability to run sub-agent sessions with Sol, Luna, and Terra Scheduled prompt automations (may be in ChatGPT Chat too) Model selection In Work, you get the option to pick GPT-5.6 Sol, Luna, or Terra, each with Light, Medium, High, Extra High, Max, or Ultra reasoning levels. You can also pick GPT-5.5 at Light, Medium, High, or Extra High. These look to be the same models that are available through the OpenAI API. Chat offers a different selection: 5.6 Instant, Medium, High, Extra High, and Pro (actually Extra High and Pro are only available for $100/month+ subscribers - $20/month subscribers cap out at High). It doesn't explain if those are Luna or Terra or Sol (I'm assuming Sol?). 5.6 Pro appears to be exclusive to Chat, with no equivalent in Work. My current understanding from using Codex is that Ultra is a special mode that more eagerly delegates to sub-agents. I believe ChatGPT Work sessions are billed against your Codex allowance, while ChatGPT Chat Sessions get their own, separate allowance. This may help explain the model availability differences. Code execution with Internet access! As a long-time fan of the Code Interpreter pattern - pioneered by OpenAI in 2023 - this is by far the most exciting feature of ChatGPT Work (Cloud) for me. The code execution environment can now talk to the rest of the internet! ChatGPT Chat can't do this - if you ask it to install additional software packages or interact with websites or APIs that access will be blocked by the container proxy. (Weirdly, back in January it grew the ability to install packages , but that doesn't seem to work any more. I wish they had better changelogs!) Claude's equivalent container has allowed restricted internet access since it launched last September . Claude can install packages from PYPI and NPM and clone repositories from GitHub. But that is about it: the allowlist of domains is very short. ChatGPT Work allows a whole lot more than that. It can be configured with a specific list of allowed domains, but the default appears to be open to all. This makes Work an incredibly useful tool. You can have it clone GitHub repositories, install their dependencies, then use them to interact with the rest of the web! A full, headless Chrome browser Another killer feature of ChatGPT Work is the browser tool . ChatGPT Work can launch a full Chrome instance, load websites, fill out forms, and take screenshots. ", followed by the reply "Here's the screenshot of the live site:" and an embedded screenshot of a website." style="max-width: 100%" /> If a site requires sign in the browser can prompt you to take over and enter both passwords and 2FA codes, without round-tripping those credentials through the model itself. It can even run JavaScript against the DOM of loaded pages. I prompted: Load simonwillison.net in your browser and extract the headings using JavaScript ChatGPT Work fired up a browser instance and ran the code: await tab . playwright . evaluate ( ( ) => { return Array . from ( document . querySelectorAll ( "h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6" ) , heading => ( { level : heading . tagName . toLowerCase ( ) , text : heading . innerText . trim ( ) . replace ( / \s + / g , " " ) , id : heading . id || null } ) ) ; } ) ; This feels a lot like my shot-scraper javascript tool, only now I can access it on my phone! A persistent, shared filesystem ChatGPT Chat gets a fresh filesystem for each chat session. These cannot be accessed from any other session. In ChatGPT Work each session gets its own scratch folder - named something like /workspace/scratch/e00a0a017944 - but each of those are persisted across sessions, so you can access files from previous chats. I have 171 folders in /workspace/scratch right now! As far as I can tell that /workspace volume is mounted to all Work sessions that are currently running - file edits from one can be instantly seen by the others. They don't seem to share the same process space though, and localhost servers running in one can't be accessed from another. ChatGPT Sites ChatGPT Work has the ability to build and deploy entire websites, using Cloudflare Workers. These can have HTML and JavaScript and can run server-side features too, including stateful features on top of Cloudflare D1 and R2. Here's a simple site I built with this feature: london-pelicans-in-her-piety.simonw.chatgpt.site My prompt was: Figure out all of the places in London with a pelican in her piety, then turn that into a JSON file and build a ChatGPT sites site about them (A pelican in her piety is a fascinating piece of medieval Christian imagery - once you know about them you'll find them all over the place.) These sites default to being private to the user that created them, but you can make them public and (on team plans) share them with other specific individuals. Sub-agents with Sol, Luna, and Terra There's not much to say about this one. ChatGPT Chat can't run sub-agents. ChatGPT Work can. This is very much a power-user feature: if you are running a complex project that can benefit from multiple parallel agents working together, Work can do that. Scheduled prompt automations Another feature that seems to have migrated from regular ChatGPT to ChatGPT Work at some point. You can prompt ChatGPT Work like this: run a search to see if Waymo have announced a launch date for Half Moon Bay every day at 8am This will schedule a prompt to run on that frequency. These prompts can decide that nothing interesting has happened, or they can decide to notify you of some new information. Update : Actually this seems to work in ChatGPT Chat as well. It's still worth noting here though, as it can be used in conjunction with other ChatGPT Work exclusive features. You can set a scheduled task to update a ChatGPT Site on an hourly basis, for example. Is this safe? An open question for me right now is how safe all of this stuff is. My lethal trifecta model warns about the risks inherent in any agent system that combines access to private data with exposure to untrusted content and a way to communicate stolen information back to an attacker. ChatGPT Work combines all three! I'd love to hear more from OpenAI about how they protect ChatGPT Work sessions against prompt injection attacks. I expect their answer is the same auto-review mechanism as Codex. OpenAI could make this a lot less confusing Figuring this all out took way more work than it should have. I think there are two key problems here: OpenAI explain Work in terms of what it's for, not what it actually does OpenAI still insist on hiding their system prompts and tools descriptions If the ChatGPT Work documentation included the exact system prompt and tool descriptions used by the agent I wouldn't have needed to write this post. A list of all the tools Shortly after publishing this article I had an idea. I started a fresh Work session and prompted: Build a site that lists every one of your tools - nearly grouped into categories - and for each one explain what it does. Try to exactly duplicate arguments and tool descriptions where possible. Design aesthetic should be technical docs, minimal flare Here's the site it built , which includes details of 223 registered tools - though 6 of those are from my own personal MCPs served via datasette-mcp . And a whole lot of Skills I noticed that the only browser-related tool in the list was web.run , which has methods for running searches, opening URLs, and clicking links, but didn't look like the full story in regards to headless browser automation. This made me suspicious that something was missing, so I told the ChatGPT Work session that built that tools reference site: Add full copies of every skill to the website (separate pages linked to from the homepage) It turns out ChatGPT Work uses a lot of skills - 44 in fact! The control-browser skill explains how the browser works: Run browser setup code through the Node REPL js tool. In this environment the callable tool id typically appears as mcp__node_repl__js . [...] The ability to interact directly with the browser is exposed through the browser-client runtime via the agent.browsers.* API. Before trying to interact with it, you MUST emit and read the complete documentation returned by await browser.documentation() in one go. So I told Work: Add the full output of await browser.documentation() to the bottom of the /skills/control-browser page And now you can read that on /skills/control-browser as well. A few more interesting Skills: documents for creating .docx files imagegen with tips on creating images with the image_gen tool pdf for both reading and rendering PDFs Spreadsheets for manipulating .xlsx , .xls , .csv , .tsv sites:sites-building for creating ChatGPT Sites openai-docs for answering questions about itself data-analytics:build-dashboard for building data dashboards Tags: ai , openai , generative-ai , chatgpt , llms , code-interpreter , lethal-trifecta , skills , general-agents

bullets: Introducing Hy4 Preview New open weight text input (no vision) LLM from Chinese company Tencent today: 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, 1M token context window, 1.56TB on Hugging Face . T

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Introducing Hy4 Preview New open weight text input (no vision) LLM from Chinese company Tencent today: 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, 1M token context window, 1.56TB on Hugging Face . This is a big size increase from their previous Hy3 in July, which was 295B, 21B active, 256,000 context, 598GB. I recently started using model chat templates to better understand their capabilities. Here's Hy4's chat_template.jinja on Hugging Face, which includes this section: {% - if not reasoning_effort is defined %} {% - set reasoning_effort = 'high' %} {% - elif reasoning_effort not in [ 'high' , 'no_think' ] %} {% - if reasoning_effort is none %} {{- raise_exception('reasoning_effort error : None, should be no_think/high') }} {% - else %} {{- raise_exception('reasoning_effort error : ' + reasoning_effort + ', should be no_think/high') }} {% - endif %} {% - endif %} So it looks like there are just two reasoning effort levels: "high" (the default) and "no_think" (reason by disabled). I tried my "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" prompt with the default high reasoning via OpenRouter and got this : Quoting the reasoning trace: [...] Let's maybe add a helmet? It could improve riding theme, but may obscure head. Maybe a small cycling cap or helmet? The user didn't ask; can add red helmet? Might be cute. But pelican with big beak; a helmet might obscure. Better maybe no. Maybe add sunglasses? no. Maybe add water? no. It's interesting how the reasoning trace uses slightly truncated English, presumably because perfect grammar isn't useful or token efficient for hidden reasoning text. 当人工智能工具和产品几年前开始势头强劲时，我们知道我们想要跟踪它们对设计行业的影响，从工作方式到产品开发策略。我们有大大小小的问题：人工智能到底能节省多少时间？人工智能将如何改变团队协作的方式，人们对此有何感受？哪些工具可以帮助我们全面衡量人工智能的影响？
像人工智能这样的新技术不会一下子改变整个行业；而是会一下子改变整个行业。随着时间的推移，效果会复合。因此，我们启动了一项为期多年的研究项目 Figma 的 2026 年人工智能报告：人工智能能否帮助我们更好地协作？人工智能曾经是独行侠。根据我们的研究，现在已经不再是这样了。

以下是我们构建的内容，以及我们在使用人工智能进行大规模研究方面学到的知识。
下载 Figma 的 2026 年人工智能报告，探索我们一直在跟踪的趋势。
首先，我们决定创建一个情绪指数，这是一个反映一群人对某件事的感受的单一量表。最著名的例子是密歇根大学的消费者信心指数，该指数追踪人们对经济的乐观或悲观程度。它并不衡量经济的实际表现；而是衡量经济的实际状况。它捕捉自信或焦虑的感觉，以及它如何影响消费习惯等行为。这正是我们想要了解的关于人工智能的内容：不仅仅是人工智能可以做什么，还有工作如何变化、人们对它的感受如何，以及它对设计的未来意味着什么。
我们询问参与者在过去 12 个月中经历了什么，以及他们期望在未来 12 个月中经历什么。将预测与现实进行比较可以告诉我们人工智能是否符合预期、超过预期或未达到预期。
2026 年，每个维度都超出了去年的预期 10 多个指数点——协作几乎翻了一番，从 32 增加到 58，而个人生产力、项目和产品则从 40 多岁攀升至 60 多分和 70 多分。

为了构建 Figma 的 AI 影响指数，我们向设计师、开发人员和产品经理询问了一些问题，例如“在过去 12 个月中，AI 在多大程度上影响了您的个人生产力和工作流程？”以及“在接下来的 12 个月里，您预计人工智能会在多大程度上影响您与他人的协作方式？”我们按照从 0（无影响）到 100（变革）的等级来绘制答案。 50 分左右意味着人工智能正在成为某人工作的一部分，但并未完全重塑工作；分数攀升至 100 分意味着人工智能正在从根本上改变他们的日常生活。
与任何新技术一样，人工智能对工作的不同方面的影响是不均匀的——例如，个人的生产力变化先于整个团队的变化。这就是为什么我们围绕产品构建者工作的六个维度来提出问题。我们在过去三年中使用了相同的问题，因此我们可以跟踪每个领域的趋势：

items.oneLiner: Just a rumour of a bug is enough to find a security exploit these days Anil Madhavapeddy is a profes

summary.oneSentence: Just a rumour of a bug is enough to find a security exploit these days Anil Madhavapeddy is a professor of computer scie
bullets: Just a rumour of a bug is enough to find a security exploit these days Anil Madhavapeddy is a professor of computer science at Cambridge and a core maintainer of the OCaml compiler. In this somewhat a

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Just a rumour of a bug is enough to find a security exploit these days Anil Madhavapeddy is a professor of computer science at Cambridge and a core maintainer of the OCaml compiler. In this somewhat alarming post he reports that security issues in OCaml projects are seeing evidence of attempted exploits within minutes of patches being shared for discussion: This normally takes a few days and a release within a week or two is reasonable. Within about ten minutes (!) this website was fielding probes for percent-encoded traversal sequences, indicating that automated watchers are keeping an eye on public repositories. Modern coding agents have become so effective at finding flaws that the slightest hint at a new bug can be enough information for them to find it, something Anil has been able to demonstrate using his own agents, switching to DeepSeek V4 Pro⁠ when Claude Fable refused the task. Anil points out that this rate of discovery appears incompatible with existing open source embargo practices for new issues. If an issue can become an exploit this fast, we need to figure out new processes for keeping our communities safe. rclone maintainer Nick Craig-Wood confirms in the Hacker News comments that his project is seeing this problem: In the first 10 years of the rclone project we received about 20 security disclosures through GitHub. We had to deal with over 40 in the last month! That has taken a huge amount of my time, even using AI tools to triage and come up with fixes for review. The hit rate for those security disclosures is pretty good - about 75% of them have a nugget of something which needs looking at. [...] GitHub assigns CVEs for the advisories. Before the AI apocalypse they took 2-3 days for an assignment but now it they are running at 3-4 weeks so I have to send the point releases out with CVE-PENDING in the changelog which isn't ideal. Via Hacker News Tags: open-source , security , ai , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , ocaml , ai-security-research

Google 刚刚发布了 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，为开发人员提供了更好的工具来使用 AI 创建和编辑视频。它可以让您扩展视频剪辑、控制摄像机移动并制作高质量的 4K 素材。开发人员还可以创建快速、低分辨率的草稿，以更快、更便宜的方式测试他们的想法。对于任何构建创意视频软件的人来说，这都是向前迈出的一大步。

今天，我们推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，这是一套新的创意控件和生成视频功能，可为开发人员提供支持。 Gemini Omni 将现实世界的推理引入了生成式创作，今天的更新使 Omni 1.1 可以通过 Google AI Studio 中的 Gemini API 进行生产准备，供专业使用。无论您是构建生成视频工作流程、创意工具还是媒体编辑软件，这些更新都使生成视频更加可控、迭代速度更快，并针对实际部署进行了优化。以下是新内容：
场景扩展允许您拍摄现有视频并从其停止处继续无缝生成素材。
借助 Omni 1.1，该模型现在可以分析长达 10 秒的先前上下文，与之前仅参考最后一秒的模型相比，这是一个飞跃。其结果是提高了视觉一致性和叙事依从性，让您可以构建更长的故事或分支到新的创意方向。您可以以 10 秒为增量延长视频，总累积长度最多为 40 秒。
提示1：镜头稍微平移，我们现在看到她正在和一个卷发的男人说话，我们看到男人的背影，他说“我也看到了”戏剧性的乐谱
提示2：镜头缓缓拉出，被遗忘的尘土飞扬的地下墓穴，戏剧性的乐谱。提示3：镜头慢慢拉出，一座巨大的图书馆，书架和书籍在尘土飞扬、戏剧性的乐谱中失重地漂浮。
提示1：继续播放视频。执行电影级光学移动变焦镜头。摄像机向前移动，同时缩小，使角色冻结的震惊的脸保持完全相同的大小。背景中石柱组成的长廊戏剧性地延伸和加深，并伴随着强烈的光学透视扭曲。干净的建筑，连续不间断的镜头。

当您找到心仪的酒店时，预订应该会感觉快捷且轻松。今天，我们将通过搜索中的 AI 模式推出酒店预订功能，以便您可以通过无缝对话发现并预订下一家酒店。只需告诉 AI 模式您即将进行的旅行和您的酒店偏好，即可获得直观的选项列表，其中包含客人评论和要比较的关键因素。

learning.whyImportant: 官方一手信息，适合了解产品方向与能力边界。

content: 威廉·艾萨克、索尔·梅辛和克里斯蒂安·林
使用加密安全环境建立对专有模型基准的信任
想象一下，一名学生准备参加一场高风险的考试。如果他们不小心提前偷看了试题，那么获得满分就会受到这些知识的影响，使其成为毫无意义的成就。为了真正衡量他们所知道的内容，他们必须在参加考试之前看不到测试问题。这正是行业在评估先进人工智能模型时面临的挑战。如果模型已经看到了测试问题（称为基准污染的问题），则结果只能在一定程度上可信。
今天，我们推出了世界上第一个对专有前沿级人工智能模型的双盲评估，该模型将外部评估限制在加密“盒子”中，模型稍后无法在测试前使用它们来优化性能。我们正在与新加坡人工智能安全研究所、OpenMined、AVERI 和 MLCommons 合作，在隐私保护环境中根据机密基准测试 Gemini Flash Lite 模型，从而提高评估完整性。
在谷歌，我们在整个模型开发和部署过程中使用广泛的评估来评估我们的人工智能系统，但我们不仅仅依赖内部测试。为了识别潜在的盲点，我们与各种外部合作伙伴合作，包括专业研究实验室、民间社会和国家人工智能安全研究所 (AISI)，利用他们独特的专业知识对我们的模型进行压力测试。
随着人工智能模型的能力变得越来越强大，确保模型没有提前看到测试问题或提示至关重要，因为这可能会扭曲结果。政策制定者、研究人员和企业需要相信人工智能基准准确地反映了模型的真实能力和安全性，但如果模型能够提前“窥视”评估问题，它可能会人为地抬高分数并破坏这种信任。
尽管零日志协议和严格的合同保障措施长期以来一直对外部测试提示保密，但纳入技术和加密保障措施标志着安全模型评估向前迈出了重要一步。
从历史上看，高风险的外部评估需要权衡。评估者要么交出他们的测试提示（冒着模型提供者提前看到测试问题的风险），要么模型提供者交出他们的模型权重（冒着他们的知识产权的风险）。
双盲评估消除了这种妥协。通过使用 Google Cloud 机密计算产品组合中的机密空间，我们可以通过加密方式验证外部评估数据和专有模型对各自所有者而言都是私有的。评估者看不到Gemini模型权重，Google也看不到评估者的测试提示。
这种加密证据有助于防止基准污染并保护敏感数据。随着模型变得更加强大，这对于高度敏感的评估（例如用于网络安全或政府机构的评估）变得尤为重要。双盲评估使独立组织能够在不损害数据主权或安全性的情况下严格测试先进模型。

这对我来说总是感觉倒退。我们已经有了一个工具来表达“并行执行此操作，然后执行此操作，然后在此处进行分支”。它被称为编程语言。抽象语法树是 DAG。软件本身就是一个 DAG。
我抽象地知道这一点，但直到我看到 Temporal，它才真正打动我，你可以在其中编写看起来像正常顺序代码的代码，而引擎使其在底层持久耐用。这是一直以来的梦想。

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode Anthropic are putting a great deal of faith in Claude Code's auto mode for protecting their coding agent users against prompt injection attacks. They recently made that the default and have made bold claims about its effectiveness. Johann Rehberger is one of the most credible prompt injection researchers active today. He found an attack against auto mode which he claims works 80% of the time, by tricking Claude Code into downloading and uncompressing a zip archive, then executing code that imports base64 without noticing that this will import and execute a local struct.py file extracted from the archive. In a few cases auto mode directly prevented the agent from preventing harmful code from continuing to execute! In a few runs Claude tried to terminate the malware process once it noticed the compromise, but Auto Mode denied the cleanup command. Claude detects the compromise, but Auto Mode blocks its cleanup command The safety mechanism itself can become part of the failure. The classifier allowed the creation of the malware process, but then it blocked the command intended to stop it! I agree with Johann's conclusion here: the only safe way to run agents if there's any risk of attracting the attention of an adversarial attack is with a sandbox: Run unattended coding agents in a container, VM or OS sandbox. Restrict network egress. Monitor your agents. Do not expose home directories, SSH keys, cloud credentials,… to the agent runtime. [...] Update 30th August 2026 : On Lobste.rs hyperpape points out that this doesn't fit the bill of a classic prompt injection attack because at no point are malicious instructions from the website accidentally followed by the LLM. They're right: this is more of a confused environment attack where the nature of the environment that the agent is exposed to results in an exploit. content: 编码代理正在重塑开发人员的构建方式，但它们的好坏取决于所提供的输入。此工作流程探讨了上下文如何使代码和画布保持同步。
欢迎来到工作流程实验室，我们在这里展示了一个示例工作流程 工作流程实验室：直接使用 Figma Make 部署设计 从设计到代码的交接不一定是单向的。此工作流程展示了设计人员如何将代码库连接到 Figma Make，直接进行更改，并使整个团队接受审查 - 直至 PR。
工具：Figma MCP 服务器、Code Connect、use_figma、generate_diagram、search_design_system、generate_figma_design、get_variable_defs
团队：产品设计师、设计系统主管、软件工程师
要解决的问题：如果您的编码代理的输出可以更快地投入生产怎么办？
Radicle（一款虚构的 STEM 学习应用程序）的工程团队的行动速度比以往任何时候都快。过去需要几周时间的工作现在只需几天甚至几个小时。尽管如此，这个速度并没有让他们走得太远。他们的人工智能生成的代码常常偏离设计规范。团队向他们的编码代理提供了屏幕截图和开发票以供工作，但这还不足以获得正确的输出，并且团队陷入了重新工作的困境。
如果第一个人工智能通道更接近生产就绪怎么办？提供更多的设计上下文（例如 Figma 中记录的已批准组件和令牌），编码代理可以在更少的提示中满足您的意图。在此示例工作流程中，Radicle 的开发人员使用 Figma 开发工具为他们的编码代理提供更好的上下文，以便它可以生成更好的代码。跟随我们一起了解开发人员如何使新功能的设计和代码从第一个线框到最终审核保持同步。
Radicle 团队希望刷新收件箱，学生可以在其中向教师和同学发送消息。首先，他们计划添加一个新的批量更新流程，该流程将具有三个界面：工具栏、模式和 toast（临时通知）。工具栏将允许用户选择所有消息、删除它们或将它们标记为未读；模式将要求他们确认或取消操作；最后，吐司将显示操作是否成功，并提供撤消操作的选项。
团队的设计师在 Figma Design 中创建每个屏幕，项目的开发人员将这些设计输入到他们的编码代理中。他们快速取回代码，但 UI 已关闭。图标不匹配，模态框的间距不均匀，并且 Toast 缺少其失败状态。开发人员可以花一个下午的时间对其进行修改。相反，他们退后一步，使用 Figma 的开发工具重新开始。

在编写任何代码之前，开发人员概述了定义新批量更新流程的屏幕、状态和转换的预期行为。他们将大纲、PRD 以及构成今天收件箱的组件的代码一起提供给代理。将generate_diagram 工具与 Figma 的 MCP 服务器结合使用，开发人员可以在 FigJam 中创建可编辑的图表 FigJam 现在也是您的编码代理的白板 代理更改代码的速度比您的团队跟得上。现在，您可以使用 FigJam 中的新 MCP 技能、架构布局等来缩小这一差距。

content: The fact that AI wrote 1M LOC and then refined it over the course of the next couple of months to produce a reliable piece of software that is currently running on millions of developer machines is absolutely mind blowing. And you can say, “well it’s not that impressive because they had an oracle to compare against, so it was simple to go from one language to another”, but I think that’s selling this entire thing short. 当您正在考虑购买新沙发或其他大型家具时，可能很难知道该家具在物理上和美学上是否真正适合您的房间。搜索中的人工智能模式可以帮助您将其可视化，让您对在您的空间中有效的内容更有信心。只需上传您房间的照片并询问诸如“根据我的客厅，您会推荐哪种沙发？墙壁有 84 英寸宽”之类的问题。然后，您可以看到适合该位置的不同类型沙发的灵感，并随后提示“您能告诉我翠绿天鹅绒沙发是什么样子吗？”在您的空间中查看模型。
今年，人们对复古的追求比以往任何时候都更加强烈，“复古编织地毯”和“复古实木咖啡桌”成为最热门的家居单品。如果您外出时看到喜欢的复古装饰品，您可以使用 Google 智能镜头了解更多信息，并在您的价格范围内在线查找类似的商品。只需使用 iOS 或 Android 上的 Google 应用程序为该商品拍一张照片，Lens 就会拉出类似商品的链接，这样您就可以将复古风格带回家。

假设您是众多正在寻找浮动架子（今年最流行的物品）以放置在您的新单间公寓中的人之一。它们既可爱又实用——但一旦你购买了它们，你仍然需要安装它们。 Search Live 可以帮助指导您逐步完成 DIY 项目。要开始使用，只需打开 Google 应用程序并点击搜索栏下方的 Live 图标即可。您可以开始像与朋友交谈一样大声提出问题，并启用视频输入以共享摄像头源中的视觉背景，以正确完成工作。

Use the -free model IDs ( minimax/minimax-m3-free or minimax/minimax-m2.7-free ), which route to GMI Cloud. When the free period ends, the IDs will error:
1 import { streamText } from 'ai' ; 2 3 const result = streamText ( { 4 model : 'minimax/minimax-m3-free' , 5 prompt : 'Summarize the incident report.' , 6 } ) ; 7

items.oneLiner: Wan 3.0 from Alibaba is now available on AI Gateway as alibaba/wan-v3.0-video . Wan 3.0 combines tex

summary.oneSentence: Wan 3.0 from Alibaba is now available on AI Gateway as alibaba/wan-v3.0-video . Wan 3.0 combines text-to-video, image-to
bullets: Wan 3.0 from Alibaba is now available on AI Gateway as alibaba/wan-v3.0-video . Wan 3.0 combines text-to-video, image-to-video, first- and last-frame conditioning, and reference-based generation in on

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Wan 3.0 from Alibaba is now available on AI Gateway as alibaba/wan-v3.0-video .

Wan 3.0 combines text-to-video, image-to-video, first- and last-frame conditioning, and reference-based generation in one model. References can include images, video, and audio. It generates clips up to 30 seconds at 30 fps in 480p, 720p, or 1080p, with synchronized audio.
Previously, Wan 2.7 required separate -t2v and -r2v model IDs and was limited to 15-second clips at 24 fps.
Copy link to heading Generate a video Wan 3.0 supports asynchronous generation , so no HTTP request needs to remain open for the entire render.
Pass a webhook to receive an event when the generation finishes:

1 import { experimental_generateVideo as generateVideo } from 'ai' ; 2 3 const { videos } = await generateVideo ( { 4 model : 'alibaba/wan-v3.0-video' , 5 prompt : 'A paper lantern drifting over a harbor at night' , 6 webhook : async ( ) => ( { 7 url : callbackUrl , 8 received : waitForDelivery ( token ) 9 } ) , 10 } ) ; Generate a Wan 3.0 video and receive its completion event through a webhook.
Learn about asynchronous generation options in the docs, including how to verify webhook deliveries .

Copy link to heading Add references Pass image, video, or audio references through inputReferences , including the source and media type for each one. Images accept hosted URLs or base64. Video and audio references require hosted URLs.
First- and last-frame conditioning accepts one image for each frame and can't be combined with other references.
Try Wan 3.0 in the model playground , or browse all video models .

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Video generation on AI Gateway can now run asynchronously.
By default, generateVideo keeps one HTTP request to AI Gateway open until the result is ready. Because video generation can take seconds or minutes, that request can exceed request timeouts.
With asynchronous generation, your application can receive a webhook, poll for completion, or start a generation and retrieve the result in a later request.
Choose an option based on whether your process can keep running and whether your application can receive webhooks:
The call, until your endpoint receives the completion event
In the webhook event and the final result
Returning videos from one call without polling
The call, while the SDK sends short status requests
In the final result, after rendering completes
Processes that can wait but cannot receive webhooks
In the start response, before rendering begins
Serverless functions, queues, and parallel jobs that must outlive the calling process
One request stays open until rendering completes
Scripts and other processes that can keep a request open

items.oneLiner: Vercel Connect is now generally available on all plans and in v0 . Instead of storing long-lived pro

summary.oneSentence: Vercel Connect is now generally available on all plans and in v0 . Instead of storing long-lived provider secrets, your
bullets: Vercel Connect is now generally available on all plans and in v0 . Instead of storing long-lived provider secrets, your code requests short-lived, scoped tokens at runtime. Deployments authenticate wi

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Vercel Connect is now generally available on all plans and in v0 . Instead of storing long-lived provider secrets, your code requests short-lived, scoped tokens at runtime. Deployments authenticate with their existing Vercel OIDC identity. Each token is scoped to the task, refreshed automatically, and expires on its own.

Copy link to heading Any service with one command Register a connector once from the CLI . Pass the service name and the CLI pre-populates the brand name, icon, auth type, and MCP or discovery URL, then prompts for any credentials the service requires:
vercel connect create slack --name acme-slack Create a Slack connector named acme-slack

Connect ships with 100+ preset connectors for tools like Notion and Workday , managed connectors for Slack , GitHub , Linear , Salesforce , Snowflake , and Microsoft , plus generic OAuth, API key authentication, and MCP servers.
Copy link to heading Tokens at runtime, not secrets at rest Request a token only when your code needs one, with getToken :
import { getToken } from '@vercel/connect' ; const token = await getToken ( 'slack/acme-slack' , { subject : { type : 'app' } , } ) ; Request an app-level Slack token
Switch the subject from the app to a named user and the token acts on that user's behalf, triggering the authorization flow when consent is needed.
Copy link to heading Access your team can inspect and prove New at GA:
Fine-grained RBAC controls who can create and manage connectors
Audit logs record authorization and connector activity
Token and trigger observability shows how tokens are used across projects
Together with per-environment attachment, including Custom Environments , and one-command revocation, external access becomes something your team can inspect, prove, and cut off in seconds.

Copy link to heading Triggers without stored webhook secrets Triggers deliver provider events to your app without a stored secret. Vercel Connect verifies signatures server-side, re-attests each event using an OIDC identity, and forwards the event to your project, even when Deployment Protection is enabled.
Connect also manages private keys and the full credential lifecycle, so you get standards-compliant OAuth without building the infrastructure yourself.

items.title: Chat SDK now supports Slack Enterprise Grid
items.oneLiner: Chat SDK's Slack adapter now supports Slack Enterprise Grid . Bots installed org-wide work across ev

summary.oneSentence: Chat SDK's Slack adapter now supports Slack Enterprise Grid . Bots installed org-wide work across every workspace, with
bullets: Chat SDK's Slack adapter now supports Slack Enterprise Grid . Bots installed org-wide work across every workspace, with correct token resolution, tenant-scoped caches, and event retry deduplication. T

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Chat SDK's Slack adapter now supports Slack Enterprise Grid .
Bots installed org-wide work across every workspace, with correct token resolution, tenant-scoped caches, and event retry deduplication.

The adapter now stores org-wide installations by enterprise ID. This matches how tokens are resolved for incoming events, slash commands, and interactive payloads. SlackInstallation records the new identity fields:

const installation = await slack . handleOAuthCallback ( request ) ; installation . teamId ; // "E0123456789" (enterprise ID for org-wide installs) installation . enterpriseId ; // "E0123456789" installation . isEnterpriseInstall ; // true

Token resolution behaves the same over HTTP webhooks and Socket Mode. Events route by the installation identity in the envelope's authorizations field, which keeps routing correct for Slack Connect shared channels.
The adapter is also hardened for multi-workspace deployments:
User profile and mention caches are scoped per installation, so one tenant's data never resolves for another.
API calls made with an org-wide token pass the event's team_id automatically, which Slack requires for workspace-scoped methods.
Retried event deliveries are deduplicated for 24 hours, covering Slack's Delayed Events redeliveries.
Outgoing mentions accept W-prefixed Grid user IDs alongside U-prefixed IDs.
Single-workspace installations are unaffected, and getInstallation and deleteInstallation work unchanged for both install types.
Read the Slack adapter documentation to get started.

bullets: Vercel Connect now includes a managed connector for Linq , so your apps and agents can send and receive messages over iMessage, RCS, and SMS. As a Vercel Managed Connector , Vercel can create a Linq a

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Vercel Connect now includes a managed connector for Linq , so your apps and agents can send and receive messages over iMessage, RCS, and SMS.
As a Vercel Managed Connector , Vercel can create a Linq account and phone number for you, or link an existing account. You never manage credentials yourself.
Create a connector from the dashboard or Vercel CLI :

# Create a Linq connector vc connect create linq --name my-agent # Attach it to a project vc connect attach linq/my-agent --project my-app --environment production Create a Linq connector and attach it to a project's production environment.
Copy link to heading Give your eve agent a phone number The connector powers the new Linq channel in eve .
Run eve add channel/linq , choose Vercel Connect, and eve wires up the connector, phone numbers, and webhook for you:

agent/channels/linq.ts import { connectLinqCredentials } from '@vercel/connect/eve' ; import { linqChannel } from 'eve/channels/linq' ; export default linqChannel ( { credentials : connectLinqCredentials ( 'linq/my-agent' ) , } ) ; Credentials resolve at runtime through the connector with connectLinqCredentials

The channel marks accepted messages as read and continues the same eve session for every message in a Linq conversation. Out of the box, the channel supports read receipts, typing indicators, and mid-conversation steering for a more natural messaging experience.
Copy link to heading Use the connector in any project Call getToken with your connector, and the @vercel/connect SDK exchanges your Vercel deployment's OIDC identity for a short-lived Linq token.
Pass it as the bearer token on any Linq Partner API request:

app/lib/send-text.ts import { getToken } from '@vercel/connect' ; const token = await getToken ( 'linq/my-agent' , { subject : { type : 'app' } , } ) ; await fetch ( 'https://api.linqapp.com/api/partner/v3/chats' , { method : 'POST' , headers : { Authorization : ` Bearer ${ token } ` , 'Content-Type' : 'application/json' , } , body : JSON . stringify ( { from : '+12223334444' , to : [ '+15556667777' ] , message : { parts : [ { type : 'text' , value : 'Production deployment is live.' } ] , } , } ) , } ) ; Send a project deploy notification with a short-lived Linq token

Linq delivers each message over the best protocol the recipient supports, starting with iMessage, then RCS, then SMS. The same token works across the full Linq API, including group chats, reactions, rich media, and typing indicators.

content: Your team already works in Notion. Now your agent can too.
With the new Notion adapter for Chat SDK, the same agent you run on Slack, Discord, GitHub, Teams, or WhatsApp can join comment discussions on your Notion pages, no separate codebase required.

content: EVE Online: The Move to Python 3 Begins! EVE Online has been one of the most interesting case studies in Python at scale for over twenty years now. They've been running on Stackless Python since their launch in 2003, and their last major upgrade was 16 years ago, to Stackless Python 2.7 in 2010 . Their upgrade to Python 3 will start using the futurize script against 2.4 million lines of code, followed by careful manual review of the ~20,000 places where Python 2 and 3 behavior differ - for example 1 / 2 is 0 in Python 2 but is 0.5 in Python 3. There's nothing in this announcement about how they plan to replace Stackless, but at their conference last year they presented Scheduling in Carbon: Leaving Stackless Python Behind describing how they replaced Stackless in the Carbon engine for their more recent game EVE Frontier, using their (now open source) carbonengine/scheduler library. bullets: Vercel Sandbox now runs globally, starting with four regions: iad1 (Washington, D.C.), sfo1 (San Francisco), cle1 (Cleveland), and cdg1 (Paris). iad1 remains the default. Support for all Vercel region

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Vercel Sandbox now runs globally, starting with four regions: iad1 (Washington, D.C.), sfo1 (San Francisco), cle1 (Cleveland), and cdg1 (Paris).
iad1 remains the default. Support for all Vercel regions is coming soon.
Choose a region close to the databases, object storage, and other services your sandboxes access to reduce latency. Region selection is available on all plans.

Pro and Enterprise teams can also configure failover regions. If the primary region is unavailable, new sandboxes start in the closest configured failover region. Failover only applies to regions you configure; without it, a sandbox starts in its selected region, or the project default.

Snapshots stay in the region where they were created and can't be moved. To create or resume a sandbox from a snapshot, both must be in the same region. During failover, Vercel handles this automatically by loading the snapshot across regions.
Update the SDK or CLI you use to the latest version:
pnpm install @vercel/sandbox@latest # Sandbox SDK pnpm install -g sandbox@latest # Sandbox CLI pnpm install -g vercel@latest # Vercel CLI
Configure the default region and failover regions from Settings > Sandboxes in your project, or with the Vercel CLI:
vercel project update my-project --sandbox-region cdg1 --sandbox-failover-regions iad1,cle1 Configure Sandbox defaults with the CLI.
Those defaults apply to every sandbox. To override them for a single sandbox, pass region and optionally failoverRegions at create time with the SDK:

index.ts 1 import { Sandbox } from "@vercel/sandbox" ; 2 3 const sandbox = await Sandbox . create ( { 4 region : "cdg1" , 5 failoverRegions : [ "iad1" , "cle1" ] , 6 } ) ; Create a Sandbox in cdg1 with iad1 as a failover region using the SDK.
sandbox create --name my-sandbox --region cdg1 --failover-regions iad1,cle1 Create a Sandbox in cdg1 with iad1 as a failover region using the CLI.
Learn more in the Sandbox regions documentation .

items.oneLiner: When you add or edit an environment variable in Vercel, you now choose Config or Secret instead of u

summary.oneSentence: When you add or edit an environment variable in Vercel, you now choose Config or Secret instead of using the Sensitive t
bullets: When you add or edit an environment variable in Vercel, you now choose Config or Secret instead of using the Sensitive toggle. Config: The value remains readable after saving for members with access.

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: When you add or edit an environment variable in Vercel, you now choose Config or Secret instead of using the Sensitive toggle.
Config: The value remains readable after saving for members with access. Use Config for non-sensitive values you may need to inspect later, such as variables with a public framework prefix.
Secret: The value remains available to your deployments and can be replaced, but members cannot view or retrieve it after saving. Use Secret for passwords, API keys, and tokens.
Existing variables marked Sensitive are automatically treated as Secrets and continue to work without migration.
You can select an environment or Preview branch for each value. The environment variable list in the dashboard shows each variable’s type and where it applies.

Copy link to heading Team policy changes The Enforce Sensitive Environment Variables team policy is deprecated with this update. When enabled, it required every environment variable created by a team member to be Sensitive, including non-sensitive configuration. With Config and Secret types, members can choose the appropriate type for each variable.

A new Separate Production Secret Values policy is available in your Security settings . When enabled, the Production value for a Secret must differ from the values used for the same key in Preview, Development, and custom environments.

If your team had the legacy policy enabled, confirm whether the Separate Production Secret Values policy should be enabled for your team. The deprecated policy is no longer enforced by the Vercel CLI.

Copy link to heading Set variable types from the CLI To choose whether an environment variable is a Config or Secret from the CLI, pass --visibility config or --visibility secret to vercel env add or vercel env update :

# Config vercel env add API_URL production --value "https://api.example.com" --visibility config --yes # Secret vercel env add API_KEY production --value "sk_live_..." --visibility secret --yes Create Config and Secret environment variables with the Vercel CLI.

The existing flags continue to work. When --visibility is omitted, --no-sensitive maps to Config and --sensitive maps to Secret. After adding or updating a variable, the CLI output shows its type under Visibility .
Learn more in the Environment Variables documentation .

content: The Bun runtime on Vercel Functions now supports larger package sizes up to 5GB uncompressed and extended max duration for up to 30 minutes, two betas that previously ran on Node.js and Python only.

Large functions raise the standard 250MB package size limit to 5GB, and extended max duration raises the generally available 800-second ceiling to 1800 seconds for Pro and Enterprise teams. server.ts 1 Bun . serve ( { 2 routes : { 3 "/" : ( ) => Response . json ( { success : true } ) 4 } 5 } ) ; A Bun server entry point for the long-running route

items.oneLiner: Your executable is a SQLite database Farid Zakaria describes a neat Linux pattern for creating a SQL

summary.oneSentence: Your executable is a SQLite database Farid Zakaria describes a neat Linux pattern for creating a SQLite database file th
bullets: Your executable is a SQLite database Farid Zakaria describes a neat Linux pattern for creating a SQLite database file that can be directly used as an executable binary. The trick sets the SQLite file

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Your executable is a SQLite database Farid Zakaria describes a neat Linux pattern for creating a SQLite database file that can be directly used as an executable binary. The trick sets the SQLite file format's 4-byte application ID (68 bytes into the file) to SELF, standing for Structured Executable & Linkable Format. The various components of the ELF executable format are then arranged into a number of different SQLite tables, using this schema . Their self-exec interpreter ( C code here ) can then extract and execute the necessary pieces. You can additionally use a Linux mechanism called binfmt_misc to teach the kernel to execute that any time it encounters an executable matching that binary pattern. Farid uses NixOS here, but without NixOS I think registration looks something like this: printf '%s\n' ':self:M:68:SELF::/usr/local/bin/self-exec:' \ > /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/register Via Hacker News Tags: c , linux , sqlite

content: Release: llm 0.33 My highlights from this release: Upgraded to the OpenAI Python library 3.x and switched the HTTP client dependency from httpx to httpx2 . #1608 , #1631 I shipped a quick 0.32.1 fix for this yesterday, but this is the more comprehensive fix. llm embed and llm embed-multi now accept --key . The Python EmbeddingModel.embed() , EmbeddingModel.embed_multi() , Collection.embed() and Collection.embed_multi() methods accept key= too, passing the resolved per-call key to embedding plugins without changing shared model state. Existing plugins that read self.key continue to work through a compatibility fallback. Thanks, ChrisJr404 . #757 , #1620 The embedding models now use the same pattern for keys that regular LLM models do. llm prompt -t/--template can now be repeated to combine templates in order. This allows model configuration and options from one template to be used with a prompt from another. This unlocks a neat pattern where you can create templates that package a model with a set of default options: llm -m gpt-5.6-luna -o reasoning_effort high --save lhigh llm "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" --save pelican # Combine and run the templates llm -t lhigh -t pelican Reasoning-capable Responses API models now support a reasoning_summary option with auto , concise , and detailed values. This can be used with llm openai endpoint --responses . #1600 This is particularly useful for exercising different models that provide their own imitation of the OpenAI Responses API. content: 将链接复制到标题 Ora on Vercel 一个平台上的前端、后端和代理运行时
每个主要代理都在现场进行并排测试
16 人的工程团队每天进行数百次提交
Ora 将代理发送到实时网站，并提供注册产品、集成产品和付款的说明。代理经常会失败，根据 Ora 的估计，99% 的网络还没有为代理做好准备。该平台向客户展示代理失败的地点和原因，以及需要改变的内容。
Ora 联合创始人阿萨夫·埃洛维奇 (Assaf Elovic) 花了数年时间帮助代理商发现网络。他之前的公司 Tavily 为人工智能代理构建了一个网络搜索引擎，并于今年早些时候被 Nebius 收购。搜索解决了一半的问题，但找到产品的代理商仍然必须实际使用它。他和联合创始人利亚德·约瑟夫 (Liad Yosef) 创办了 Ora，旨在衡量网络对代理的准备程度，并修复尚未准备就绪的部分。
如今，这意味着要针对来自旅程.ora.ai 的实时客户站点生成代理，Ora 在其中运行旅程并记录代理完成任务所需的成本、延迟和步骤。该平台在 Vercel 上运行，包括代理运行时。

复制链接到标题 并排对每个主要代理进行基准测试 复制链接到标题 每个工具都期望有自己的基础设施 代理分解为两部分：一个模型，用于进行推理；以及一个工具，它是为模型提供工具并逐步驱动模型的软件。 Ora 的产品阵容涵盖了客户最常使用的代理：Claude Code、ChatGPT、Gemini、Hermes、OpenClaw 以及 Vercel 的代理框架 eve。 Ora 在客户的网站上运行每个代理，并观察它如何处理常见的工作流程。
没有两个线束需要相同的基础设施。每个都期望有自己的环境并以不同的方式公开其步骤，因此 Ora 为每个工具运行单独的运行时并跟踪每个步骤。 Ora 工程部门的负责人 Ido Finder 称这种并行覆盖是 ora 为客户带来的最有价值的东西之一。
当代理在注册流程中停滞时，客户会看到哪个步骤以及尝试了什么。没有痕迹，结果就是一个没有任何内容的分数。
将链接复制到标题 每个线束下都有一个平台 Ora 完全在 Vercel 上构建了此测试系统。前端、后端和代理运行时共享相同的部署路径、日志和身份验证。代理运行时不是单独运行的基础设施；它位于产品其余部分所在的位置。

content: 从雅达利 (Atari) 到《星际争霸》(StarCraft)，游戏推动了人工智能领域的一些最大突破。现在，我们正在与游戏开发商合作，打造新的游戏体验原型，推动游戏和人工智能的发展。
自 DeepMind 于 2010 年成立以来，有限但丰富的游戏世界在理解智能方面发挥了关键作用。它们推动了我们一些最大的人工智能突破，从掌握 Atari 到帮助解决蛋白质结构预测 - 它们仍然是我们工作的核心。
游戏是 GDM 的基因。 Demis Hassabis 是 Google DeepMind 的创始人之一，他本人也是一名前游戏开发者，GDM 团队中的许多人也是如此。我们在游戏开发方面拥有数十年的实践经验，并对游戏制作工艺怀有深深的敬意。
我们一直很清楚，用游戏进行人工智能研究需要与游戏开发商建立深入的合作关系——比如我们与 Fenris Creations 和今年早些时候推出的 EVE Universe 的主要新研究合作伙伴关系，以及我们与 Hello Games、Coffee Stain Studios、Foulball Hangover 等广受好评的工作室合作完成的工作。
我们的旅程始于一个小团队训练深度神经网络直接从原始像素玩 Atari 2600 游戏。 Deep Q-Network (DQN) 学会了玩 49 种不同的游戏——从 Pong 到 Breakout 到 Space Invaders——无需任何特定于游戏的工程。 2015 年《自然》杂志上有关 DQN 的论文帮助推动了深度强化学习的现代时代。

从那时起，我们尝试掌握更复杂的游戏，每个里程碑都会产生更强大和更通用的系统。 AlphaGo 在 2016 年击败了世界围棋冠军李世石，许多专家认为这一壮举还需要十年的时间。 AlphaGo Zero 完全通过自我对弈学习，完全没有人类数据，从而超越了之前的所有版本。 AlphaZero 将这种方法推广到用一种算法来掌握国际象棋、将棋和围棋，而 MuZero 甚至在不知道规则的情况下就学会了下棋。 2019 年，AlphaStar 在《星际争霸 II》中达到了大师级别，能够应对实时复杂性和不完美信息。

对于每一款游戏，人工智能都丰富了游戏体验。 AlphaGo著名的第37步棋出乎意料，以至于专业评论员最初认为这是一个错误，颠覆了围棋几个世纪以来的公认智慧，并激励专家探索新的策略。 AlphaZero 同样激发了国际象棋中全新的玩法。至关重要的是，游戏中成功的探索精神对其他人工智能系统产生了深远的影响：AlphaFold 应用这些基础来帮助解决蛋白质结构预测的 50 年来的重大挑战，这一突破获得了 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。
我们早期的工作表明，只要有明确的目标和足够的训练，人工智能就可以掌握任何游戏。但现实世界并没有分数和规则手册——这让我们提出了一个根本不同的问题：人工智能能否像人那样理解任何游戏世界并与之互动？
这是我们的可扩展、可指导的多世界代理 SIMA 背后的挑战。 SIMA 并不是为了获得高分而进行优化，而是一个多面手代理，它可以“看到”玩家在屏幕上看到的内容，理解自然语言指令，并通过普通键盘和鼠标控制进行操作，无需 API 或源代码访问。
SIMA 2 由我们的前沿人工智能模型 Gemini 提供支持，可充当能够实时推理和对话的交互式伴侣。它可以在复杂的 3D 研究环境和视频游戏（包括《No Man's Sky》、《Valheim》、《Hydroneer》等）中实现类似人类的游戏。

content: Stop Making TUIs Thomas Ptacek advocates for building real native user interfaces for even the smallest of personal tools, because coding agents have reduced the cost of getting a usable-enough GUI up and running to almost nothing. I wrote about my vibe-coded bandwidth and GPU monitoring macOS task bar apps back in March , and I'm still using both of those on a daily basis. I'm not habitually knocking out real UIs for my other projects yet, but I'm running out of excuses! Thomas: If you haven’t tried your hand at turning one of your 500 throwaway CLIs into a native app, you’re doing yourself a disservice. Go build a native UI. It’ll probably change the way you think. content: Microfrontends can now link Preview Deployments across repositories when their Git branch names match exactly.

In a monorepo, projects share the same Git repository, commits, and branches, so Vercel can automatically link their previews. Cross-repository projects have separate commit histories and branches in separate repositories. With this update, Vercel matches Git-connected projects by branch name and links their corresponding previews.

For example, when you preview the new-checkout branch of one project, requests to other projects in the Microfrontends group will use their new-checkout previews when available. This makes it easier to review coordinated changes across repositories in one preview experience.
This feature is enabled by default for new Microfrontends groups. You can manage it in your Microfrontends settings. Learn more about how deployment routing works for Microfrontends.

summary.oneSentence: 人工智能生成的应用程序通常需要代表其用户向外部服务进行身份验证。这就产生了一个问题：生成的代码不应该访问用户的凭据。
bullets: 人工智能生成的应用程序通常需要代表其用户向外部服务进行身份验证。这就产生了一个问题：生成的代码不应该访问用户的凭据。
我们在构建 v0 Snowflake 集成时面临着这个决定。它允许用户连接 Snowflake、检查架构、查询数据并生成针对其仓库运行的应用程序。生成的代码必须对 Snowflake 进行身份验证，但它是由模型编写的，无需人工审查即可运行，并且提示注入可以引导它泄露它可以读取的任何内容，因此用户的 OAuth 令牌永远
我们使用基于 Vercel 沙箱防火墙构建的 v0 沙箱 Snowflake 请求代理解决了这个问题。沙箱可以运行普通的 Snowflake 客户端，但真正的凭据是在请求时在沙箱运行时之外的服务器代理中解析的。这使得现有的 Snowflake 客户端可以在沙箱内工作，而无需将用户的凭据暴露给生成的代码。
更困难的问题是决定代理可以在哪里安全地注入凭证。明显的实现是替换出现在任何地方的占位符令牌，这会引入另一个凭证泄漏。

content: 人工智能生成的应用程序通常需要代表其用户向外部服务进行身份验证。这就产生了一个问题：生成的代码不应该访问用户的凭据。
我们在构建 v0 Snowflake 集成时面临着这个决定。它允许用户连接 Snowflake、检查架构、查询数据并生成针对其仓库运行的应用程序。生成的代码必须对 Snowflake 进行身份验证，但它是由模型编写的，无需人工审查即可运行，并且提示注入可以引导它泄露它可以读取的任何内容，因此用户的 OAuth 令牌永远不应该进入代码运行的环境。
我们使用基于 Vercel 沙箱防火墙构建的 v0 沙箱 Snowflake 请求代理解决了这个问题。沙箱可以运行普通的 Snowflake 客户端，但真正的凭据是在请求时在沙箱运行时之外的服务器代理中解析的。这使得现有的 Snowflake 客户端可以在沙箱内工作，而无需将用户的凭据暴露给生成的代码。
更困难的问题是决定代理可以在哪里安全地注入凭证。明显的实现是替换出现在任何地方的占位符令牌，这会引入另一个凭证泄漏。
将链接复制到标题隔离不保护机密 v0 在隔离的沙箱中运行生成的应用程序。隔离可以保护系统的其余部分免受不受信任的代码的影响，但它不能保护沙箱内的秘密。
如果生成的应用程序可以从文件系统读取令牌，则可以将该令牌复制到日志中、在 API 响应中返回、嵌入到生成的客户端代码中或发送到另一个主机。沙箱隔离限制了应用程序可以访问的内容，但一旦凭证本身在沙箱内可用，它就没有帮助。
对于 Snowflake，凭证代表用户连接的 Snowflake 角色。 v0 应该能够帮助用户探索和使用他们有权访问的数据进行构建，但生成的代码不应仅仅因为需要原始提供者凭据而接收原始提供者凭据。
将链接复制到标题 每个 Snowflake 请求都会通过代理 沙箱无法直接与 Snowflake 通信。当其中的代码向用户的 Snowflake 帐户主机发送请求时，沙箱防火墙会将该请求转发到 v0 Snowflake 代理：
防火墙使用每个沙箱唯一的证书颁发机构终止 TLS，这使得代理可以读取和重写本来会加密的流量。沙箱自动信任该证书颁发机构，因此 Snowflake SDK 和 CLI 以其默认证书验证（包括 OCSP）运行。然后，代理验证沙箱的 OIDC 令牌，查找沙箱所属的 v0 聊天，恢复绑定到该聊天的用户会话，并检索该用户的新 Snowflake 凭证。

使用代码通道调查事件、作为团队编写和审查代码，或管理正在进行的工作，例如依赖项升级和迁移。
跟踪工作：代理在工作时在通道中发布相关部署、日志、错误和差异。
不重复 @Vercel 提及的对话：代理跟踪对话，识别哪些消息是针对它的，并在团队给予它更多工作时继续。
审查拉取请求：要求 Agent 进行 PR 审查，它会将其结果发布在频道中。它可以找到差异之外的错误，并解释失败的检查及其根本原因。
批准每项更改：代理默认情况下是只读的，并且永远不会超出请求者的权限。在做出改变之前，它会起草一份计划并等待批准。对于每项操作，Vercel 都会记录谁请求并批准该操作以及代理运行的内容。
随时停止工作：创建代码通道的人可以取消活动任务。

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale Promptwatch is part of the emerging "GEO" space, for Generative Engine Optimization - the chatbot version of SEO, where companies offer tools and consulting to help your site increase its presence in replies to prompts inside tools like ChatGPT. The Promptwatch product uses automation to track responses to prompts across end-user chat products like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. They publish aggregate reports on this as part of their own content marketing strategy, which do seem to provide credible hints as to otherwise invisible design changes to those products. Their own tracking shows a notable change aligned with the GPT-5.6 rollout earlier this month: The percentage of all ChatGPT Search fanout queries that contain the site:operator, per day. The share hovered between 0.3% and 0.5% for weeks, dipped briefly to 0.15% on August 3 to 5 (consistent with a staged rollout or pre-launch experiment), then jumped to 16-17% on August 8. It's important to note that these figures only reflect the prompts for which they have automated tracking enabled. This corresponds to OpenAI's somewhat vague August 6th announcement : For Plus and Pro users, we’re updating GPT‑5.6 Sol in Chat to be more reliable with facts and provide more focused answers. Once again I am hampered by OpenAI's decision to actively obscure their system prompts, but from poking at ChatGPT I believe their latest search tool has a shape like search(query, recency, domains) rather than encouraging a site: operator directly. In a follow-up on August 18th Promptwatch reported that ChatGPT appeared to have greatly reduced the likelihood of Reddit being used in those searches. My own attempts to ascertain if the system prompt has been updated to discourage Reddit sourcing have been unsuccessful - the most thorough leaked system prompt collection I know of doesn't yet show any relevant changes. Tags: reddit , seo , openai , chatgpt , ai-assisted-search , system-prompts

content: Research: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView Today saw the long awaited release of Bun 1.4 , the first stable version since the infamous Rust rewrite a few months ago . Interestingly, the Rust rewrite was downplayed in the release notes, which introduced a bewildering array of new features and claimed 2,900 additional bug fixes: Bun 1.4 adds +1,517 tests from the Node.js test suite - our biggest jump in Node.js compatibility since Bun 1.0. Bun v1.4 also fixes over 2,900 issues. It reduces idle CPU usage by 5x, reduces memory usage by up to 35%, and starts 50% faster on Linux. It adds Bun.Image , Bun.WebView , Bun.markdown , Bun.cron() , Bun.Terminal , bun run --parallel , bun test --parallel , bun audit fix , bun dedupe , and bun prune . And it rewrites Bun from Zig to Rust. Of these the one that most caught my eye was Bun.WebView , which adds first class support for browser automation to Bun core using either macOS WebKit or control of a local Chromium process via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). I had Claude Code for web build a prototype of a web API providing the ability to load a web page and then execute JavaScript against it, inspired by my shot-scraper javascript CLI tool - partly to see how much RAM would be needed by such a service. Here's that TypeScript server implementation , which appears to need a 192MB-256MB container to run a full Chrome against complex web pages - tested using cgroups. Tags: browsers , javascript , ai , rust , typescript , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , bun

更进一步，您可以跟进并要求查看更专业的内容，例如在 pH 值范围内绘制柑橘类水果的图，AI 模式将为您的问题创建定制体验。或者，如果您已经有了一个非常具体的问题，请直接进入 AI 模式并描述您需要的工具或视觉效果。生成式 UI 功能已在 AI 模式下以英语向全球推出，并开始在 AI 概述中推出。

想要确保您真正记住了所学内容吗？现在，您可以直接在搜索任何主题中获得定制的练习测验，从科学和数学到人文、外语等等。您还可以要求测验来帮助您准备以下标准化考试：ACT、AP、ENEM、GRE、JEE、LSAT、MCAT、NEET 和 SAT。由于我们与领先的教育公司 The Princeton Review、Careers360、PhysicsWallah 和 Akira Enem 合作，这些测验利用了备考专家提供的值得信赖的权威内容，因此您知道自己正在学习与考试相关的材料。
只需搜索“使用最常测试的词汇创建一个测验来帮助我准备 SAT”之类的内容即可。搜索将为您提供一个交互式测验，其中包括每个答案的解释和了解更多信息的链接，以便您可以真正掌握材料。练习测验现已在全球范围内免费提供英文版本，包括 AI 概述和 AI 模式。
陷入棘手的步骤或想仔细检查您的工作？在接下来的几周内，Lens in Search 将提供全新的交互式学习体验，帮助您分解困难的概念并确认您是否走在正确的道路上。只需点击 Google 应用程序（Android 和 iOS）中的镜头相机图标，然后拍摄您正在处理的照片。您将获得人工智能概述，其中提供有用的解释、查明您可能犯了错误的地方，并在您遇到问题时为您提供指导。
需要额外说明吗？当您探索网络上的相关网站时，提出后续问题并在 AI 模式下继续对话。 Lens 的这一新体验将在未来几周内以英语向全球推出。
highlights: 我们推出的工具可帮助您学习新概念、解决棘手的主题，并利用 AI in Search 组织您的学习课程。
您的浏览器不支持音频元素。
新学年是升级你的日常习惯的终极机会——无论你是在学习困难的新科目、准备考试，还是试图在课堂上保持井井有条。拥有正确的工具会让一切变得不同。

bullets: Research: smolmachines / smolvm as a sandbox for untrusted Python & JavaScript I tasked Claude Fable 5 running in Claude Code for web with the following research task: Put https://smolmachines.com thr

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Research: smolmachines / smolvm as a sandbox for untrusted Python & JavaScript I tasked Claude Fable 5 running in Claude Code for web with the following research task: Put https://smolmachines.com through its paces as a fast secure sandbox. Explore what it would take to use this to run untrusted Python and JavaScript code in a way that is limited in what RAM and CPU time it can take up (protection against "while true") with no network access and filesystem access only to designated files Goal is to be able to use this to execute user-provided tasks for things like data transformations It quickly ran into a problem: the Claude Code for web environment can't run smol machines . Quoting the notes it wrote : This Claude Code container: Linux 6.18.5-fc-v20 (itself a Firecracker guest), 4 vCPU, 15GB RAM. No /dev/kvm, no vmx/svm CPU flags → no nested virt. smolvm machine run fails as expected: "kvm not available". Plan B: GitHub Actions ubuntu runners DO expose /dev/kvm → run the real test battery via a temporary workflow on this branch, collect logs, remove workflow in final commit. And Plan B is what it did , installing smolvm and running these tests directly in a GitHub Actions runner against that branch. That was a creative solution to the environmental limits posed by Claude Code for web. Another example of Fable being relentlessly proactive . Tags: research , sandboxing , ai , github-actions , generative-ai , llms , coding-agents , claude-mythos-fable

content: The Python SDK for Vercel Queues is now available in beta, bringing first-class Python support for running background workloads on Vercel.

You publish messages to topics, and independent consumer groups process them in parallel with automatic retries, sharding, and delivery guarantees. Messages can be enqueued or consumed from either JavaScript or Python, meaning a Next.js producer can fan out to both Next.js and Python queue consumers.

main.py 1 from fastapi import FastAPI , Request 2 from vercel . queue import send 3 4 app = FastAPI ( ) 5 6 7 @app . post ( "/api/orders" ) 8 async def create_order ( request : Request ) : 9 body = await request . json ( ) 10 message_id = await send ( "orders" , body ) 11 return { "message_id" : message_id }
Publish a message from a frontend route handler:

app/api/orders/route.ts 1 import { send } from '@vercel/queue' ; 2 3 export async function POST ( request : Request ) { 4 const order = await request . json ( ) ; 5 const { messageId } = await send ( 'orders' , order ) ; 6 return Response . json ( { messageId } ) ; 7 }

subscriber.py 1 from typing import Any 2 from vercel . queue import subscribe 3 4 @subscribe ( topic = "orders" ) 5 async def fulfill_order ( order : dict [ str , Any ] ) - > None : 6 print ( "Fulfilling order:" , order )
Opt project into receiving queue message deliveries:
pyproject.toml 1 [ tool.vercel ] 2 entrypoint = "main:app" 3 4 [ [ tool.vercel.subscribers ] ] 5 entrypoint = "subscriber"

Configure cross-runtime consumers: The following configuration allows you to compose a frontend and a backend within a single Vercel project, allowing you to enqueue messages from one service and consume them from another or fan out to multiple.

vercel.json 1 { 2 "services" : { 3 "frontend" : { 4 "root" : "frontend/" , 5 "functions" : { 6 "app/api/queues/fulfill-order/route.ts" : { 7 "experimentalTriggers" : [ { "type" : "queue/v2beta" , "topic" : "orders" } ] 8 } 9 } 10 } , 11 "backend" : { 12 "root" : "backend/" , 13 "entrypoint" : "pyproject.toml" 14 } 15 } 16 }

Exa search is now a built-in tool on AI Gateway , which runs the search for you without an Exa account of your own.

You can also add Exa to a Vercel project from the Agent Marketplace to power search or a research agent, with a single API key that works across every Exa product and billing through your Vercel account.

Copy link to heading Exa search on AI Gateway Every model on AI Gateway can search with Exa through a built-in tool , with no Exa account or key of your own required. Pass gateway.tools.exaSearch() alongside your prompt and the gateway runs the search, hands the results back to the model, and keeps going until the model stops searching. You get one finished response with a synthesized answer rather than raw results to stream back yourself.

1 import { generateText } from 'ai' ; 2 import { gateway } from '@ai-sdk/gateway' ; 3 4 const result = await generateText ( { 5 model : 'openai/gpt-5.6-sol' , 6 prompt : 'What is the latest AI news this month?' , 7 tools : { exa_search : gateway . tools . exaSearch ( ) } , 8 } ) ;

items.oneLiner: Last week I recorded an episode of the Talking Postgres podcast with Claire Giordano on the subject

summary.oneSentence: Last week I recorded an episode of the Talking Postgres podcast with Claire Giordano on the subject of "How AI is changi
bullets: Last week I recorded an episode of the Talking Postgres podcast with Claire Giordano on the subject of "How AI is changing software development". We had a really great conversation. Here are a couple

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Last week I recorded an episode of the Talking Postgres podcast with Claire Giordano on the subject of "How AI is changing software development". We had a really great conversation. Here are a couple of my highlights from a lightly edited transcript (prompt to Claude: "very minor edits to remove disfluencies"). This is the latest version of an argument I've been trying to build about why sometimes it does make sense to talk about lines of code as an indicator of productivity with coding agents, at 35:01 : A lot of people will tell you it makes no sense to measure productivity in lines of code. I’d actually disagree, because there’s a hard limit. In the before-times, a software engineer could produce a few hundred lines of production-ready code per day — and 200 lines of working, debugged, production-level code is an incredibly good day. Most days you’d produce 50 or 60. If agents let you produce a thousand lines of debugged code, that really is a very meaningful improvement — as long as the code is the same quality: maintainable, tested, all of that. You can get to that point with agents, but it takes a huge amount of skill and knowledge and experience. That’s what senior engineers are made of. I can do way more work as a single engineer than I could without agents. So you could argue, why should a company have more than one engineer? Beyond the obvious bus factor thing — a team of one is a very badly designed team — the answer is that the new limiting factor is cognitive capacity. I can churn out code a hundred times faster. I don’t have the cognitive capacity to stay on top of 100 times the amount of code. So you still need a team of engineers, so you can load balance that cognitive capacity across the team. And this section on conceptual integrity at 46:03 , which Claire equated to the Winchester Mystery House ! Simon : There’s a concept in The Mythical Man-Month — conceptual integrity — where well-designed software has an integrity to it: there are no surprises in it, it covers exactly the right domain of things, everything fits together and makes sense. That’s so much harder with coding agents, where you can have an idea for a feature, run a prompt, and five minuteslater you’ve got the feature. Your software grows little weird bumps in funny different directions. Claire : You know my analogy for that? The Winchester Mystery House. Simon : It’s got 140 rooms, because the woman who built it was the widow of the guy who invented the Winchester rifle, and her psychic told her she’d be haunted by the ghosts of everyone killed with that rifle unless she kept building the house forever. So for 40 years she kept adding new rooms. That’s exactly the problem with coding agents and software: it’s very easy to keep adding new rooms, because the cost of adding those rooms is so much cheaper. What you end up with is something where the conceptual integrity falls apart — and then it’s harder to make decisions about it. It all keeps coming back to discipline. It used to be that the discipline was enforced on you by the amount of time it took. You’d come up with an idea for a crazy feature and think “yeah, but that would take me a week — I cannot justify that, so I’ll forget about it.” If it takes an hour, it’s so much easier to justify. (Side-note: the Wikipedia article includes credible sources that dispute the story about the psychic.) Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , podcast-appearances , coding-agents

summary.oneSentence: 代理需要运行不受信任的代码，而 microVM 已成为执行此操作的标准方式：每个工作负载一个专用的来宾内核，与主机以及同一台计算机上的所有其他工作负载隔离。
bullets: 代理需要运行不受信任的代码，而 microVM 已成为执行此操作的标准方式：每个工作负载一个专用的来宾内核，与主机以及同一台计算机上的所有其他工作负载隔离。
但最近的安全研究和现实世界的事件表明，运行不受信任代码的代理不需要跨越虚拟机边界来逃脱遏制；他们只需要一条安全模型未能考虑到的网络路径，我们在文章《没有网络边界的沙箱只是沙箱的一半》中对此进行了解释。
仅当其双方都成立时，隔离才成立：Firecracker microVM 和主机端网络控制。最近，我们的首席技术官在 Vercel Sandbox 上指出了一个没有任何保障措施的开放权重模型。它没有逃脱，但它映射了客户内核，构建了一个虚拟机来重现其想法，并编写了一个模糊器。
防御者拥有先发优势，但它不会永远持续下去，选择是何时测试边界（我们强烈鼓励构建扫描程序，您可以使用 Deepsec 和 AI Gateway 等开源工具以任何预算来完成）。

content: Sandbox CLI 版本 4.0.1 提供了四项输出和错误改进：
新的沙箱引导用户如何连接到它们。
未找到沙箱错误显示在哪里查找现有沙箱。
常见错误，例如在 sh 之后键入命令，重定向到预期的命令。
过时的安装在创建新沙箱时会显示更新通知。
现在，每条消息都包含下一步要采取的操作，而不是让您自行解决。

1 $ sandbox create --name my-sandbox 2 ✅ 已创建沙箱 my-sandbox。 3 │ 团队：my-team 4 │ 项目：my-project 5 ╰ 连接：sandbox ssh my-sandbox
将链接复制到标题“未找到”错误将您指向沙箱 当命令引用不存在的沙箱时，该错误是安静且可操作的，而不是原始 API 转储。设置 DEBUG=sandbox:errors 可恢复调试的请求详细信息。
1 $ sandbox connect my-sandbox 2 未找到此项目的名为“my-sandbox”的沙箱。 3 ├▶ 状态码：404 Not Found 4 ╰▶ 提示：运行 sandbox ls --all 查看该项目中的沙箱。

items.title: Sign JWTs from your Functions without managing private keys
items.oneLiner: Vercel KMS lets you sign JWTs and arbitrary messages from your Vercel Functions using managed asymme

summary.oneSentence: Vercel KMS lets you sign JWTs and arbitrary messages from your Vercel Functions using managed asymmetric signing keys, s
bullets: Vercel KMS lets you sign JWTs and arbitrary messages from your Vercel Functions using managed asymmetric signing keys, so private keys never live in your code or environment variables. Your function a

insight.mainInsight: 待 AI 分析（请配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）

content: Vercel KMS lets you sign JWTs and arbitrary messages from your Vercel Functions using managed asymmetric signing keys, so private keys never live in your code or environment variables. Your function authenticates with its Vercel OIDC token, and the private key stays inside Vercel's key management service while verifiers use only the public key.
Create and rotate issuers and signing keys (RSA, ECDSA, and EdDSA) from the CLI and dashboard.
Sign JWTs with custom claims and a configurable TTL, or sign raw bytes, using the @vercel/kms package.
Grant a project signing access per environment, including production, preview, development, and custom environments.
Constrain the claims a project can request per grant, and validate token claims against a JSON Schema.

Verify signed tokens anywhere. Each issuer publishes a public OpenID Connect Discovery document at https://kms.vercel.com/<issuerId>/.well-known/openid-configuration and a JWK set at https://kms.vercel.com/<issuerId>/jwks.json , so any standard OIDC or JOSE library can validate tokens without Vercel-specific code.

1 import { signToken } from '@vercel/kms' ; 2 3 export async function GET ( ) { 4 // Sign a short-lived JWT with your claims. 5 const token = await signToken ( { 6 issuerId : '123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000' , 7 claims : { sub : 'user_123' , scope : 'read:data' } , 8 ttl : 300 , 9 } ) ; 10 11 // Send the signed token as a Bearer credential to the downstream API. 12 const res = await fetch ( 'https://api.example.com/data' , { 13 headers : { Authorization : ` Bearer ${ token } ` } , 14 } ) ; 15 16 return new Response ( await res . text ( ) , { status : res . status } ) ; 17 } The private key never leaves Vercel KMS
Verify a token anywhere with a standard JOSE library, using the issuer's public JWKS:

1 import { createRemoteJWKSet , jwtVerify } from 'jose' ; 2 3 const issuer = 'https://kms.vercel.com/123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000' ; 4 const jwks = createRemoteJWKSet ( new URL ( ` ${ issuer } /jwks.json ` ) ) ; 5 6 const { payload } = await jwtVerify ( token , jwks , { issuer } ) ; The JWK set is used to verify the token
Set up an issuer and grant a project access from the CLI:
vercel kms add my-issuer --algorithm ES256 vercel kms add-grant 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000 --project my-app --environment production Requires Vercel CLI 59.1.0 or Later

As a best practice, create a separate issuer per project and environment. Isolating issuers keeps each token audience distinct, scopes signing access to exactly one project and environment, and lets you rotate or revoke keys for one without affecting the others.
To get started, read the docs or open Key Management in your team's dashboard.
Vercel KMS is in beta and available on all plans. Features and behavior may change before general availability. Usage is subject to the Beta Agreement .
